local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local util=require('openmw.util')
local camera=require('openmw.camera')
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local timer=0
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 timer=timer+dt; if timer<0.3 then return end; timer=0
 local obj=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x234fd))
 if not obj or not obj:isValid() then return end
 local d=obj.position-self.position
 local f=self.rotation:apply(util.vector3(0,1,0))
 local angle=math.atan2(f.y*d.x-f.x*d.y,f.x*d.x+f.y*d.y)
 local c=camera.getPosition(); local v=obj.position+util.vector3(0,0,85)-c
 local pitch=-math.atan2(v.z,math.sqrt(v.x*v.x+v.y*v.y))
 print(string.format('SeedNeeus aim x=%d y=%d distance=%.3f',math.max(-200,math.min(200,math.floor(angle*512+.5))),math.max(-150,math.min(150,math.floor((pitch-camera.getPitch())*512+.5))),d:length()))
end}}}}
